🚀 New Update (v1.0.2) by Dhiraj:
• Complete message context preservation: Full big text capture so WhatsApp & chat messages are never cut off
• Multi-message & historic chat context support (no missed messages)
• WhatsApp Group conversation auto-threading with sender attribution
• Fix for repeated update prompt loop
• 100% Data Preservation: All your existing saved messages and media remain intact
